items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Under the direction of Pinky Repolkovich, where we played nothing but stuff.

ctx.x: Yeah. So we started in there around 32. And we played up there three sessions a day. 8 to 8.30, 11.30 to 12, and 4.15 to 5.15. What was the band called? The WWL Staff Orchestra. That's all. That's the same. Under the direction of Pinky Repolkovich, where we played nothing but stuff. And our salary was $25 a week. At least.
How many years did you stay on that one?
